item.title: Last glacial North Pacific oxygenation due to North Atlantic circulation changes
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 23 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02122-x

Transient weakening of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation during the last glacial period may have led to a contraction of oxygen minimum zones in the North Pacific, according to benthic foraminifera proxy records and Earth system simulations.
